description: Capture a URL or local HTML file and host it. Shares put's attach, comment, and metadata options. `via=local` needs Chrome; `via=remote` renders server-side. localhost URLs are local-only.

alt.description: Alt text for the markdown (default: derived filename).

app.description: Which surface is shown: web, ios, android, cli. Worth setting only when the same route exists on more than one surface.

browser.description: Explicit local browser executable path (local backend only).

cdp.description: Attach to a running Chrome via CDP instead of launching one (local backend only).

colorScheme.description: Emulate prefers-color-scheme: dark | light. Full media-query emulation requires via: "local" — the remote backend only sets the CSS color-scheme property and won't flip a page's own prefers-color-scheme queries.

comment.description: With pr/issue (or auto-detected PR context): create/update the managed attachments comment (best-effort).

destination.description: Typed destination root: screenshots | gh | f. With pr/issue must be gh or omitted.

dryRun.description: Capture + resolve key/URL without uploading. Not with comment or galleryId.

frame.description: Optional frame before optimize: phone | browser | iphone-16-pro.

galleryId.description: Add the uploaded object to this public gallery.

hide.description: CSS selectors to hide (display:none) before capture. Works on both backends.

issue.description: Attach to this issue. Mutually exclusive with pr.

key.description: Explicit object key (default: <prefix>/<repo>/<ref>/<name>-<hash>.png). Cannot be combined with pr/issue.

maxHeight.description: Cap on full-page capture height in CSS px (default: 5000, 0 = uncapped). A page over the cap is clipped, with a `hint` in the result. Requires fullPage. Applied on both via: local and via: remote so behavior matches.

metadata.description: Queryable tags for later search (key→value). Use `path` for the route (e.g. /settings), not route/page/screen. Omit to leave existing tags; pass an object (even {}) to replace them. `state` and `app` have their own fields.

noGit.description: Don't derive the repo segment from git.

noHideDevTools.description: Don't auto-hide framework dev toolbars (Astro/Next/Nuxt/Vite), which are hidden by default for localhost/private-network targets.

noOptimize.description: Skip client-side image optimization (default: optimize to WebP).

noPr.description: Skip auto-PR context (issue #700): without pr/issue/key/ref/prefix/destination, a call on a branch mapping to exactly one open PR otherwise behaves as if pr had been passed. Also opts out via UPLOADS_NO_AUTO_PR=1.

optimizeMaxEdge.description: Max long edge in pixels when optimizing.

pr.description: Attach to this pull request. Mutually exclusive with issue.

reducedMotion.description: Emulate prefers-reduced-motion: reduce so animations settle. Best-effort on via: "remote" (neutralizes animations via injected CSS).

ref.description: PR/issue/branch key segment (default: today, or UPLOADS_DEFAULT_REF).

replace.description: Overwrite an existing object on a non-`gh/` key (e.g. an explicit `key`). Default false (or true if UPLOADS_OVERWRITE=1). No effect on `pr`/`issue`/branch keys, which always overwrite.

repo.description: owner/name repo segment (default: git remote, or UPLOADS_DEFAULT_REPO).

selector.description: Capture one element instead of the viewport.

state.description: The UI state this image shows. Set it whenever the image is one side of a comparison — before/after is the most useful pair in a PR, and is what makes `find_files` with state=after work later.

target.description: http(s) URL, or a path to a local .html file.

wait.description: Settle strategy: load (default) | domcontentloaded | networkidle | a millisecond count (millisecond counts are local-only — via: "local").

width.description: Emit markdown instead of a plain embed.

workspace.description: Override the workspace for this call (like the CLI's --workspace flag).

name: screenshot
title: Capture screenshot
